gap: Premise is the open update-time lower bound. Unverified: streaming model (input representation, workspace, search semantics, uniformity), time-constructibility of s(n)=2^{n/log* n}, and CJW Thm 1.6 (unread at primary source).
proved_step: Lemma T1: if for some A in PH and eps>0, infinitely many n, every poly(s)-space streaming algorithm for search-MCSP^A[s(n)], s(n)=2^{n/log* n}, on 2^n-bit inputs has worst-case update time >= 2^{eps n}, then P != NP. Proof: P=NP gives (via the proof of MMW19 Thm 1.3) an algorithm with update <= s^k = 2^{kn/log* n} for fixed k; the hypothesis gives eps <= k/log* n, false for large n.
